name: GXO IKEA Customer Distribution Center - Quakertown PA

fieldNotes.location: Roster address (150 N West End Blvd) is approximate. Web research established the true address as 3000 AM Drive #200, Quakertown PA 18951 — a large multi-tenant DC (anchor Continental Tire DC / DHL Supply Chain; GXO occupies Suite 200, ~195,000 SF for IKEA ecommerce parcel fulfillment). Racklify lists the whole building at 935,540 SF. Locked center 40.46075,-75.3475 — the large white-roofed warehouse in the AM Drive industrial park (Milford Township, NE of Quakertown borough). Neighboring building numbered '1020' visible in Street View confirms the AM Drive park.
fieldNotes.suiteCaveat: GXO operates only Suite 200 of this multi-tenant building; the geofence and dock/trailer counts cover the whole shared building and yard, which cannot be split out from overhead imagery.
fieldNotes.truckGate: No barrier arm or sliding gate visible at the truck-yard entrance off the SE road; appears to be an open paved approach. Marked false; listed uncertain — current Street View panos along the frontage are partly screened by a vegetated buffer and a utility easement.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No clear guard booth at the road entrance. A small structure exists inside the SE truck yard near the docks/water tank, but it reads as a maintenance/utility shed rather than an entrance gatehouse. Uncertain.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Cross-dock building with separate dock banks on the NW face and the SE face, each with its own yard.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Two long dock banks (NW and SE faces) with many trailers backed in; estimated ~70 total, banded 50+ (count low-confidence).
fieldNotes.dropArea: Very large trailer drop yard along the S/SE of the building with dozens of trailers in herringbone parking — well into the 50+ band.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Quakertown is a small Bucks County borough; the AM Drive industrial park sits on the rural edge in Milford Township surrounded by farmland and woods. Per rubric, classified Rural.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line passes through the woods SW of the property but does NOT spur into the building; not rail-served.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide truck yards and aprons on both faces with unused paved width.
